messages:
Maria G: FYI nightly eval (long-context suite) shows big regression on rwd-open-3-q4 warm-start run. Instr-follow dropped from 0.97 -> 0.68 for the 16k+ prompt set. Samples attached in payload.
Tess: ugh, looks like instruction truncation again? any obvious diff vs yesterday's run?
EvalBot: nightly-eval: model=rwd-open-3-q4_8x, commit=6f9a2c3, metric:instr-follow=0.68 (-0.29), top-failures=prompt_ids:[8452,8460,8475]
Josh L: I pulled a few failing examples — the model literally drops the initial instruction after ~6.5k tokens and begins continuing older conversation context.
Kai: That smells like KV warm-start offset misalign. We recently changed prefetch alignment for quantized kernels in commit 6f9a2c3.
Maria G: Repro steps I ran: 1) load session with 8k prefix, 2) append 8k user instr, 3) continue generation. On failing runs the KV read pointer seems to be shifted by one slot every ~2048 tokens.
Tess: Can you paste the log snippet where we dump kv pointers?
Josh L: snippet from runtime debug:
```
[2026-03-19T03:12:02Z] session=abcd123 prefix_len=8192 current_seq=16384 kv_base=0x7ff8 kv_slot=2047 expected_slot=2046
[2026-03-19T03:12:02Z] kv_fetch: offset=2047 -> read_seq=16383
[2026-03-19T03:12:02Z] token_emit: token_id=5023 ("please"), source=kv(older)
```
Kai: The read_seq being one behind smells like an off-by-one in the prefetch/quant-packer path that was introduced to reduce alignment stalls.
Maria G: Good catch. Nightly runner used the new quant kernel; can we force-nightly back to legacy for the next run to see if metric recovers?
deploy-bot: rollback plan available: tag=nightly-legacy-kernel, ETA=2m
Josh L: Before rolling back, can we bisect the commit range? If it's the quant prefetch change, a quick A/B between 6f9a2c0 and 6f9a2c3 should confirm.
Tess: I can run two parallel nightly jobs: one with 6f9a2c0 (legacy) and one with 6f9a2c3 (current) but limited to the 16k+ subset. Starting now.
EvalBot: job started: nightly-compare-16k subset, ids: 2185001240,2185001241
Kai: Quick hypothesis: quant warm-start path uses a different modulo when mapping absolute sequence to circular KV slots; if the new packer increments pointer post-prefetch instead of prefetch might cause steady drift at large seqs.
Maria G: If that's true, repeated sessions with different start offsets should show deterministic phase shifts. I can generate a small microbench to brute-force offsets 0..4095 and check alignment.
Josh L: Also check behavior under contiguous multi-request sessions vs single long request — we saw differences before when session anchoring code path toggles.
Tess: Test run results (first 20m): legacy job instr-follow=0.96, new-quant job instr-follow=0.69. So immediate repro. Attaching failing prompt ids again.
Kai: Ok that's enough to block shipping this quant kernel. Create a bug with triage label, assign to infra-quant.
Maria G: Filed BUG-ML-1293 with logs + minimal repro script. Assigning to @Kai. Also adding the three failing prompts as deterministic testcases in nightly harness.
Kai: Thanks. I'll revert the kernel change on staging and run the microbench. Expect a patch within the day.
Maria G: Thanks all. Please add any additional flaky prompts to the thread. :white_check_mark:
